ITB 52399JL Contract 18472, CMI Equipment Addendum, add option Line Item 11 Item | Unit Description Unit Price Bid Price shall include delivery. 2008 10 Ea Tractor / Mower, ROW $ 47,355.00 Make and Model: Offered: New Holland T5050 with Alamo Versa 11 Ea Upgrade to Alamo Interstater mower with $ 9,415.00 hydraulics and mounting kit The request is to add an Alamo “Interstater” model cutter as an option to existing competitively bid contract 18472 for a Tractor with an Alamo “Versa” cutter. Both cutting heads are similar in design, dimension and function. Both mount perpendicular to the tractor at a point about amidships and are hydraulically driven. The “Versa” cutter is designed to work as part of a multi gang cutting system, with one mower mounted perpendicular to the tractor on each side with an oversize pull behind rotary cutter mounted on a three point hitch. The ideal application would be large, open expanses such as parks or interstate medians to cut the optimal acres/hour. To this end, the mounting system is designed with the inside of the cutter at a maximum distance from the centerline of the tractor, producing a gap between rear wheel and the inside edge of the cutter head. When used as a single right of way cutter in an urban or suburban mowing application, the Versa design causes the tractor to be pushed further out into the traffic lane, resulting in an exaggerated slow moving vehicle hazard and a safety concern to both the operator and the public. Additionally, the lift system for storing and deploying the cutter head is not made for the frequent lifting and deploying required for object avoidance (mailboxes, culverts, garbage cans, etc) in the urban setting. ARCHIVE
The interstater is built to cut the same width, but closer to the centerline of the tractor. The lift system is more robust and sophisticated and locks/stores/transports in a safer manner. Both cutters have sufficient common parts and design features so as not fo require additional parts or service contracts. The tractor required remains the same for both cutter heads. ARCHIVE
